name: SAM 3 Video Mask
description: Cuts one subject out of a video as a mask: the subject white, everything else black, same frame count and frame rate as the clip. SAM 3 finds what the prompt names and tracks it through every frame. For motion-capture nodes that take a person mask video alongside the clip. Uses ComfyUI's core SAM 3 nodes, the same tracking step as its SAM 3D Body template. SAM License: https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam3/blob/main/LICENSE

prompt.description: What SAM 3 tracks, in a word or two. With more than one person in frame, name the one you want ("man", "mannequin", "woman in red").

video.description: The clip to mask, as a ComfyUI input filename.

max_objects.description: Most matches SAM 3 tracks. 1 keeps only the best match for the prompt.
